title: Chapter 217 Four-Star Zerg Mother Nest
content:
Chapter 217 Four-Star Zerg Mother Nest

In the next few days, the Naga and Tengu tribes quickly organized evacuations. The Naga territory transitioned very smoothly, but the Tengu territory was a bit chaotic.

Wu Qing and the Queen of Zerg focused their main efforts on the Tengu territory. A large number of Zerg puppies entered the Tengu territory and cooperated with the Zerg host to take over the cities directly under the Tengu tribe.

The situation of the Tengu tribe's vassal territories was relatively good. The Tengu tribe had almost no vassal territories that they really valued in this area, and they left all the vassal territories here.

Many of these Tengu vassal territories had contact with the Zerg, and coupled with the chaotic management of the Tengu tribe over the years, they were not very opposed to the Zerg taking over the territory.

Wu Qing announced the management methods to these Tengu vassal territories in a timely manner through the Zerg host.

When they learned that all vassal territories could regain their freedom and choose to join the alliance organization with a very high degree of autonomy, the lords of these Tengu vassal territories regained their long-lost passion.

This is equivalent to giving them a chance to start over. They became vassals of the Tengu tribe because they were forced by the situation. Who would really want to live under someone else's roof?

Especially as a vassal of the Tengu tribe, sometimes there is no dignity at all. They have regretted countless times. Now they finally have a chance to start over. Of course, they must seize it well.

Everyone has learned about the alliance. Various information of the alliance is not confidential. It has also been vigorously promoted. As long as you are willing, you can get a lot of information.

Struggling on a relatively free and fair platform like the alliance is much better than becoming a vassal of another tribe.

Wu Qing basically stabilized the vassal territory of the Tengu tribe, and used the Zerg army to take over the cities directly under the Tengu tribe. The management personnel selected by Daxia Territory went to various cities through transport hosts and began to take over the management of the city.

The area of the territory controlled by the Zerg has become larger, and the role of transport hosts has greatly increased. Wu Qing has increased the number of transport hosts according to needs.

The first thing the management personnel sent from Daxia Territory did when they arrived at the target city was to issue a recruitment order to continue recruiting talents.

These cities have a large population, and among them there must be all kinds of capable people. They are very familiar with all walks of life in the city, and they are the talents that are urgently needed.

The recruitment order of Daxialing, which recruits talents without restrictions on identity, soon attracted a large number of people to come and apply for self-recommendation after publicity.

The Queen of Insects personally assessed these people through the Zerg host, screened out the available people, and entrusted them with important tasks.

When everyone saw that the people they once knew became the managers of the city overnight, the power of this example was infinite.

A large number of people who were still hesitating joined the assessment army of the Recruitment Hall.

With enough available manpower, they were bound to special Zerg unit identity cards, and these people were included in the control of the Queen of Insects.

The Queen of Insects effectively managed the city through these people.

As the Tengu tribe evacuated, the Zerg took over and constantly calmed down the various chaos caused by the Tengu tribe's departure and looting.

When the huge space transmission channel of the Tengu tribe was officially closed and dismantled, and the Tengu tribe's strongmen escorted them away, it marked the end of the Tengu tribe era here and the beginning of the Zerg era.

The Zerg prioritized the smooth acceptance of the most troublesome Tengu territory, and the acceptance of the Naga territory became very easy.

For the cities directly under the Naga tribe, the Queen only needed to conduct an assessment of the existing managers and bind the Zerg identity cards to the qualified people.

Facts have proved that the management of the Naga tribe is very good, and most of the managers they left behind can pass the Queen's assessment.

As long as the Zerg sent a Zerg puppy army to garrison, the Naga tribe's cities directly under the Naga tribe would be taken over.

As for the vassal territories of the Naga tribe, many of them were the source of soldiers cultivated by Naga, and the territories of races such as the Feather Tribe followed Naga left.

Those left were some ordinary vassal territories, and Wu Qing treated them equally, gave them freedom, let them join the alliance and develop on their own.

The territories of the Bear Goblin tribe were all empty cities, so they were left for the time being.

After the continuous cleanup of the demon tribe territories during this period, the remaining forces of the demon tribe have been completely cleared.

Most of the rescued people were not suitable for normal management because their minds were severely damaged by the demons. The Queen of Zerg controlled the Zerg to intervene in the management.

At the current stage of the development of the Zerg, the Queen of Zerg's spiritual power is unfathomable. She will conduct some testing mental treatment on these people.

If these people can recover, there will definitely be many people with very strong spiritual will. Such people are rare talents.

After the Queen of Zerg's teaching, their future is limitless.

…

After all this trouble, the Zerg finally has a complete territory recognized by all parties in this world, and it can be regarded as having its own sphere of influence.

The main force of the Zerg that cleared the remaining enemies in the demon territory completed the task and returned to the Zerg territory.

They joined the main force that had been fighting in the underground world and assembled into a huge army consisting of more than 400,000 Zerg Hydralisks, more than 200,000 Zerg Cockroaches, 150,000 Zerg Dragons, Zerg Destroyers with more than 20,000 troops, 5,000 Zerg Stealth Spiders and countless Zerg Puppies.

This army is also assisted by special units such as Zerg Overlords, Zerg Queens and Zerg Scourge.

The main combat force of the Zerg is nearly one million, and the number of Zerg puppies is countless. This is the army lineup that Wu Qing prepared to completely capture the territory of the Ghoul Clan.

Before officially attacking the territory of the Ghoul Clan in the underground world, Wu Qing still has an important thing to do.

When the Zerg army was in a decisive battle with the demon army, the beheading action of the Zerg Queen had already made the Zerg mother nest meet the conditions for upgrading to four stars, that is, killing one enemy with five-star strength.

Every time the Zerg mother nest is upgraded by one level, all the upgrade options related to the Zerg arms can be upgraded once.

As long as the Zerg mother nest is upgraded, the upgrade building evolution chamber of the ground force and the upgrade building air force tower of the air force can continue to upgrade the attack and defense power of the Zerg ground and air forces.

There are also special upgrade buildings for each type of troops, such as the mother nest corresponding to the Zerg host, the hatching pool corresponding to the Zerg puppy, the hydralisk nest corresponding to the Zerg hydralisk, the queen nest corresponding to the Zerg queen, and the corresponding buildings for the self-developed troops, etc.

The upgrade options related to the capabilities of each type of troops in these Zerg buildings can be upgraded once.

These upgrade options, consuming resources once, can improve the capabilities of all corresponding troops. This is the most effective way to essentially improve the strength of the entire Zerg!

As long as the Zerg mother nest is upgraded once, the combat power of the entire Zerg will be qualitatively improved.

The combat power of the ground forces such as Zerg Workers, Zerglings, Hydralisks, Roaches, Destroyers, and Stealth Spiders and the air forces such as Zerg Dragons, Explosive Mosquitoes, Queens, and Hosts will be stronger, and the special abilities of Zerg Queens and Hosts can also be enhanced.

Wu Qing chose the mother nest for upgrading. As long as a Zerg mother nest is upgraded to four stars, the entire Zerg will enter the four-star era.

In the four-star era, in addition to the improvements brought by the various upgrade options mentioned above, the strength star level of each Zerg troop can be directly upgraded to the highest upper limit of four stars.

As long as resources are consumed, the Zerg can produce four-star warriors in batches at any time.

The beast cave-shaped mother nest where Wu Qing's body is located has been successfully upgraded to four stars, and the upgrade options of the entire Zerg's buildings have all been refreshed and have become upgradeable.

Wu Qing upgraded the upgradeable options of all Zerg buildings one by one.

Under the magical system rules, all Zerg units have been upgraded.

In just a short while, the combat power of the entire Zerg army has changed greatly.

Even the most basic Zerg puppy can compete with the weaker one-star troops in melee combat.

As for the four-star troops, Wu Qing temporarily upgraded only two Zerg queens to prevent the existence of strong people with strength exceeding level five in the ghouls.

There are many strong people in the ghouls, and Wu Qing has added ten Zerg queens. At critical moments, they can continue to carry out decapitation operations.

Everything was ready. Wu Qing upgraded his Zerg clone to four stars and personally led the Zerg army to launch a full-scale attack on the territory of the Ghoul Clan in the underground world.

A Zerg cockroach and two Zerg hydralisks on the left and right formed a team. More than 600,000 Zerg cockroaches and hydralisks formed a huge long snake formation, lined up in a row, and swept across the territory of the Ghoul Clan like a net.

More than 20,000 Zerg destroyers were divided into multiple small squares, followed the front army, and continuously launched ultra-long-range attacks on the densely populated areas of the Ghoul Clan's territory.

Five thousand Zerg stealth spiders were scattered behind the Zerg cockroaches and hydralisks. When they found that the position was under the greatest pressure, they went there to support and make up for the lack of firepower.

150,000 Zerg flying dragons were also divided into multiple teams, advancing synchronously from the air.

There were also a large number of Zerg puppies as reserve forces, plus the secret protection of Zerg explosive mosquitoes and queens, as well as Zerg hosts scattered everywhere, representing the ultimate power of the queen, Wu Qing tried his best to be foolproof.

The underground world, for the Zerg, still had too many unknowns. Wu Qing was now going to destroy the ghouls, and he didn't know if there would be any changes.

The "booming" explosion sounded throughout the territory of the ghouls in the underground world.

Countless ghouls turned into light and disappeared under the attack of the Zerg army, and the bone blood pools where the ghouls were born, which were guarded by the Zerg army with all their strength, were destroyed one by one by the Zerg army.

The Zerg army steadily advanced forward, and the speed of attack was very fast.
